sources.title: GitHub - evanzhangxin/qwen-human-eval
sources.snippet: This repository provides instructions and scripts to serve the Qwen/Qwen3-.6B model using vLLM, and evaluate its performance on the HumanEval benchmark. There are 3 steps in total for this task: Serving: Serving the Qwen3-0.6B model using vLLM. Inference: Generating code samples using the served Qwen3-0.6B model. Evaluation: Evaluating the generated code samples using the HumanEval benchmark.
